items.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Before you stands a small humanoid creature with a disproportionate head.*#WHITE#
Ah, what have we here? @playerdescriptor.race@, I believe you have turned at the wrong corner.
items.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*在你面前站着一个矮小的人形生物，长着一个不成比例的脑袋。*#WHITE#
看，来了个什么人，@playerdescriptor.race@, 我相信你一定走错地方了。

items.source: So it would seem. What is going on here?
items.target: 有可能，这里发生了什么事？

items.source:
This is my Ring of Blood! Listen, you have now two choices.
Since you do not look like slave fodder to me I will offer to let you pay to play the game.
If you feel you cannot take part in a slaver's game, I am afraid you will need to... disappear.
items.target:
这里是鲜血之环！听着，你现在有两个选择。
既然你看上去不像那些奴隶一样的炮灰，我可以让你付费参加这个游戏。
要是你不愿参加奴隶贩子的游戏，恐怕你就得……消失了。

items.source: Slavers? This is so wrong! [attack]
items.target: 奴隶贩子？这太邪恶了！[攻击]

items.source: You think so? Die.
items.target: 你这样认为？去死吧。

items.source: Game? I like playing, what's this about?
items.target: 游戏？我喜欢，是个什么样的游戏？

items.source:
Well, you see, it's quite simple. I will mentally take control of various wild creatures or slaves while you use the orb of command on the other side of this room to take control of a slave.
Then we fight using our pawns for 10 rounds. If your slave survives you will win the Bloodcaller.
items.target:
你看，很简单。我会精神控制一些野生怪物或者奴隶，你则用对面的指令水晶球来控制一个奴隶。
然后我们对战10轮，如果你的奴隶还活着，那你会赢得了一个戒指，鲜血呼唤。

items.source: What if I lose?
items.target: 要是我输了呢？

items.source: Blood, death without self-harm risks? Great fun!
items.target: 鲜血和死亡，但自己却不用冒生命危险，太有趣了！

items.source: Normally you would be taken as a slave, but you look like you would be more useful as a full-time player, so you can just try again.
items.target: 一般你自己会成为我的奴隶，不过你看上去应该是个不错的选手，你可以再次尝试。

items.source:
Superb. Oh yes, before I forget, to use the orb you will need to pay the standard fee of 150 gold pieces.
I'm sure this is small money to an adventurer of your class.
items.target:
好极了，哦对了我差点忘了，每次使用水晶球你得支付150金币。
对于你们这种冒险家来说我想肯定不过是九牛之一毛而已。

items.source: 150 gold? Err... yes, sure.
items.target: 150金币？呃……好吧当然。

items.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*You place your hands on the orb.*#WHITE#
You must provide 150 gold to take part in the fight.
items.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*你把你的手放在水晶球上。*#WHITE#
你必须支付150金币参加比赛！

items.source: [Pay 150 gold]
items.target: [支付150金币]

items.source: [Leave]
items.target: [离开]

items.source: Let the fight start!
items.target: 比赛开始吧！

items.source: Bring it on!
items.target: 尽管来吧！

items.source:
So, you tasted blood? Liked it? I am sure you did; you are just that kind of people.
Anyway, I suppose you deserve your reward.
You can always participate again for fun, if you've got the gold to spare.
items.target:
那……你尝到了鲜血的滋味吧，怎么样喜欢么？相信你一定喜欢，你就应该是这种人。
不管怎样，你应该得到你的奖赏。
要是你愿意花钱，你可以再来练习取乐。

items.source: Thanks, it was fun!
items.target: 谢谢，非常有趣！

items.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Before you stands a cute little orange cat. It looks hungry and looks at you.*#WHITE#
Meowww?
items.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*在你面前站着一只可爱的小猫咪。它似乎饿了，眼泪汪汪地瞅着你。*#WHITE#
喵呜...

items.source: Oh kitty kitty!
items.target: 猫咪真可爱！

items.source: No time for cats!
items.target: 我可没时间浪费在猫身上!

items.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*It rubs up against your leg and purrs.*#WHITE#
Rrrrrrrrrrrr.
items.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*它轻轻地蹭着你的腿，咕噜咕噜地叫着。*#WHITE#
呜呜...

items.source: Hey maybe you would like some of this delicious lookin troll intestines? #LIGHT_GREEN#[Feed him the intestines]#WHITE#
items.target: 小猫，你想吃点东西么？我这里正好有半截巨魔肠子，你要么？ #LIGHT_GREEN#[喂给它吃]#WHITE#

items.source: Sorry little fellow, I can't help you.
items.target: 小猫，抱歉，我帮不了你。

items.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#*It eats it all and looks happy. After a while it strolls away. Somehow you feel you have not seen the last of it.*#WHITE#
items.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#*它全部吃光了，看起来很开心。过了一会，它就跑开了。不知为何，你感觉你还会再见到它。*#WHITE#

items.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#[Leave]
items.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#[离开]

items.source: No time to talk fellow Wayist! ATTACK! FOR THE WAY!
items.target: 没时间闲聊了，我的同胞！冲啊！为了维网！

items.source: [leave]
items.target: [离开]

items.source: The foolish cultist that created me is no more. What am I to do now...
items.target: 那个创造了我的愚蠢邪教徒已经死了。我现在应该做什么呢…

items.source: You are me, come with me!
items.target: 你就是我，和我一起走吧！

items.source: You should head back to Irkkk.
items.target: 你应该回伊尔克去。

items.source: I fear that would get confusing very fast. I think I will go back to Irkkk. Farewell my clone!
items.target: 我担心这样会让我很困惑的。我觉得我应该回伊尔克去。再见了，我的克隆！

items.source: Clone? No you are the clone.
items.target: 克隆？不，你是我的克隆。

items.source: Farewell.
items.target: 再见。

items.source: Sure... if you prefer to think about it this way. We are all part of The Way anyway.
items.target: 啊……如果你愿意这么想也没问题。反正，我们都是维网的一份子。

items.source: I think so too, farewell my clone.
items.target: 我也是这么想的，再见了，我的克隆。
